dct_description_sm: This dataset compiles geochemical parameters and sedimentological characteristics of 8 gravity cores (up to 38 cm) of marine sediment from the Yukon mainland coastal zone in the southern Beaufort Sea. Samples were collected during the Yukon Coast expeditions in spring 2016 and summer 2018 in water depths between 18 and 50 m. Geochemical parameters of the 178 samples include organic carbon and nitrogen (TOC, TN), as well as stable carbon and nitrogen isotopes (δ13C-TOC, δ15N-TN). Sedimentological characteristics include measurements of surface area, OC loading, as well as contents of clay, silt, and sand.
dct_title_s: Geochemical parameters and sedimentological characteristics of marine sediments off the Yukon coast, Canada
